defects.description: Destructive '전체삭제' (empties the cart immediately, no confirmation or undo) sits in the sticky bottom bar 4 px from the primary '결제하기' button (Galaxy S24: #btn-clear x16-100, #pay x104-344, both y716-768). A slightly-left touch aimed at pay lands on clear.
defects.human_factors_basis: Material Design touch-target guidance (48dp targets separated by >=8dp); Apple HIG: avoid placing destructive buttons where they can be tapped accidentally and require confirmation for destructive actions; systematic touch offsets and spread measured by Henze, Rukzio & Boll (2011, '100,000,000 taps') and Holz & Baudisch (2010) make a 0.7 mm gap (4 CSS px at ~0.18 mm/px) insufficient to separate an irreversible action from the primary one.

defects.description: Promo banner close icon is a 16x16 CSS px target placed 2 px from the '받기' button (#promo-close x318-334 y86-102; #promo-get ends at x316). The scripted task taps it.
defects.human_factors_basis: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum): target <24x24 CSS px and the 24 px circle centred on it intersects the adjacent '받기' target, so the spacing exception does not apply; also far below Apple HIG 44x44 pt and Material 48x48 dp. Fitts' law / touch-error models (Parhi, Karlson & Bederson 2006: ~9.2 mm for reliable thumb targets) predict frequent misses that would instead download the coupon.

defects.description: Installment/exclusion helper text is 11 px #b5b5b5 on #ffffff (contrast 2.05:1).
defects.human_factors_basis: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum) requires 4.5:1 for text of this size; 11 px text is additionally below common legibility minimums (Apple HIG minimum 11 pt with default 17 pt body; Material body 14-16 sp), compounding the contrast failure for reduced-acuity and older users.

defects.description: Payment-method picker shows 12 equally weighted options in a 3x4 grid with no default, no recently-used highlight and no grouping (clean variant: recently used method preselected + 2 alternatives, 9 more behind '다른 결제 수단 9개 보기').
defects.human_factors_basis: Hick-Hyman law (Hick 1952; Hyman 1953): choice reaction time grows with log2(n+1) of equally likely alternatives (12 options ~3.7 bits vs 3 options 2 bits); choice-overload literature (Iyengar & Lepper 2000; Scheibehenne et al. 2010 on moderating conditions) and progressive-disclosure guidance (NN/g) recommend defaults/prioritisation at decision points such as checkout.

defects.description: After tapping '결제하기' nothing on screen changes for 2.6 s (setTimeout 2600 ms): button stays enabled, no spinner/label change/progress, then the completion overlay appears. Measured: no DOM mutation within 1.2 s of the tap; repeat taps are silently swallowed.
defects.human_factors_basis: Nielsen (1993) response-time limits: 0.1 s feels instantaneous, delays >1 s need explicit feedback and interruptions of several seconds need a progress indicator; Doherty & Thadani (1982) ~400 ms threshold; ISO 9241-110:2020 (self-descriptiveness / feedback) requires the system to indicate it is processing. For a payment action absent feedback invites repeated taps or abandonment.

defects.description: Primary '다음' is a compact inline button left-aligned at mid-screen (Galaxy S24: x16-104, y399-443, centre (60,421) CSS px = ~(11 mm, 77 mm) from the top-left of a ~66x143 mm screen). For a right-thumb one-handed grip (thumb CMC near the right edge ~118-125 mm down) the centre is ~72-77 mm away, beyond a ~62 mm (50th percentile) functional thumb reach, so the user must shift grip or use the other hand; for a left-thumb grip it is ~44 mm away and comfortable. iPhone 15 (393x852): centre (60,421) pt, same pattern.
defects.human_factors_basis: Functional thumb-area model (Bergstrom-Lehtovirta & Oulasvirta, CHI 2014) and Hoober (2013) one-handed hold observations: targets on the far side of the screen from the holding thumb, above the thumb pivot, fall outside the reachable arc; Karlson, Bederson & Contreras-Vidal (2006) and Trudeau et al. (2012) show slower, less accurate thumb input for distant/opposite-side targets. Primary actions should sit in the natural zone (e.g., full-width bottom bar as in the clean variant).

defects.description: Quick-amount chips (+1만/+5만/+10만/+100만/전액) are 62x28 CSS px (~11.4x5.1 mm on Galaxy S24) with 4 px (~0.7 mm) gaps. They pass WCAG 2.5.8 (>=24 px) but, while walking, touch scatter makes an adjacent chip likely - a miss on '+10만' can add '+100만'. The scripted task taps '+100만' and '+5만'.
defects.human_factors_basis: Walking roughly doubles touch-point scatter and error rates (Bergstrom-Lehtovirta, Oulasvirta & Brewster, MobileHCI 2011; Schildbach & Rukzio 2010; Mizobuchi et al. 2005); recommended one-handed thumb targets ~9.2-9.6 mm (Parhi et al. 2006) and platform minimums 44 pt / 48 dp with >=8 dp spacing. At 5.1 mm height and 0.7 mm spacing the predicted miss probability under walking sigma is high while seated users are mostly fine.

defects.description: In the confirmation bottom sheet, the only recipient verification line (bank, account number, account holder name) is 12 px #555555 (7.46:1 contrast, passes WCAG) while the question headline is 20 px. For presbyopic users holding the phone at 400-500 mm this safety-critical text is hard to read, so a mis-selected recipient is not caught.
defects.human_factors_basis: Presbyopia moves the near point beyond ~40-50 cm by the 50s-60s, so small text must be read at a longer distance or without accommodation; NIA/NLM 'Making Your Website Senior-Friendly' recommends 12-14 pt (~16-19 px) body text; ANSI/HFES 100-2007 recommends >=16 arcmin (20-22 preferred) character height - 12 px Hangul (~2.0 mm on Galaxy S24) subtends ~14-17 arcmin at 400-500 mm, at or below the minimum, and older readers' critical print size is larger (Legge et al.; Chung et al.).

defects.description: When the transfer is rejected (1일 이체 한도 초과) the bottom sheet closes and the only feedback is a banner fixed under the header (Galaxy S24 y52-114) while the user's finger/attention was on '보내기' at (262,738): ~660 CSS px (~120 mm, ~22 deg at 300 mm) away, with no inline message, no focus move and no change near the tap point. The large sheet-dismiss transient coincides with the banner's appearance.
defects.human_factors_basis: Visual attention stays at the locus of action; peripheral detection falls off sharply outside the useful field of view of a few degrees (Ball et al. UFOV; Rensink 2000 on change blindness when a change coincides with another transient). Error-message guidance (NN/g; ISO 9241-110 error tolerance; WCAG 3.3.1/3.3.3 intent) calls for errors adjacent to the triggering control; the clean variant keeps the sheet open and shows the error directly above the buttons.

defects.description: The only way to commit settings ('저장') is a text button pinned to the top-left corner of the header (Galaxy S24: x4-56, y3.5-47.5, centre (30,25.5) = ~(5.5 mm, 4.7 mm)). For a right-thumb one-handed grip this is the farthest point on the screen (~130 mm from the thumb pivot); it is also out of reach for left-thumb grip (~114 mm), but worst for right-handed one-handed use.
defects.human_factors_basis: Hoober (2013) and the functional thumb-area model (Bergstrom-Lehtovirta & Oulasvirta 2014): the top corner opposite the holding hand is the hardest region for one-handed use on ~6 inch phones; frequent/primary commit actions should be in the lower, natural zone (clean variant: full-width bottom '저장').

defects.description: Switch off-state track is #e8e8e8 with a borderless white knob on a white row (1.23:1 against the background), so after the user turns marketing notifications off the switch and its state are barely visible. Measured on the switch element after the scripted tap.
defects.human_factors_basis: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast requires >=3:1 for visual information needed to identify a UI component and its state; the clean variant uses a #6b7684 off-track (4.6:1).

defects.description: Destructive '회원탈퇴' is a 56x18 CSS px text button stacked 2 px below '로그아웃' (56x18) in the footer (Galaxy S24: logout y503-521, withdraw y523-541). A slightly low tap on logout hits account deletion (mitigated only by a confirmation dialog).
defects.human_factors_basis: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8: both targets are <24 px tall and the 24 px circle centred on '회원탈퇴' intersects the '로그아웃' target (centre-to-edge 11 px), so neither size nor spacing criterion is met; Apple HIG 44 pt / Material 48 dp; placing a destructive action flush against a routine one contradicts platform guidance on destructive actions.

defects.description: Step-1 '다음' is a 56 px circular button attached to the right edge of the summary card at mid-screen (Galaxy S24: x280-336, y428-484, centre (308,456) = ~(56 mm, 83 mm)). Comfortable for a right-thumb grip (~38 mm from the pivot) but ~70-74 mm from a left-thumb pivot, beyond typical functional reach; iPhone 15 (393x852): centre (341,456) pt, same pattern.
defects.human_factors_basis: Functional thumb-area model (Bergstrom-Lehtovirta & Oulasvirta, CHI 2014); Hoober (2013): the reachable area mirrors with handedness, so a primary action placed on the right edge above the thumb pivot is a stretch only for left-hand one-handed users (roughly 10% of people are left-handed and many users switch hands); clean variant uses a full-width bottom button.

defects.description: Time-slot availability is encoded only by hue: available = green border #289828 / fill #eaf6ec, full = red border #d8383a / fill #fdeaea; same text, weight, shape; full slots do nothing on tap. The legend is itself colour-keyed. Under Machado et al. (2009) deuteranopia simulation (severity 1.0) the border colours become indistinguishable (CIE76 dE ~0) and fills differ by dE ~0.9 (normal vision: borders dE ~114).
defects.human_factors_basis: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.1 Use of Color (colour must not be the only visual means of conveying information); red-green colour-vision deficiency affects ~6-8% of men (deutan the most common form; Birch 2012). Clean variant adds '마감' text, strike-through and a dashed disabled style.

defects.description: Submitting step 2 with a missing phone number shows a summary error box at the top of the form (Galaxy S24 y64-127) while the user tapped '예약 신청하기' at the bottom (focus (180,742)) - ~650 CSS px (~118 mm, ~21 deg at 300 mm) away; no inline error at the phone field, no focus move, no scroll, nothing changes near the tap point.
defects.human_factors_basis: Useful-field-of-view and change-blindness findings (Ball et al.; Rensink 2000): changes far from the locus of attention are often missed; error-message guidelines (NN/g; ISO 9241-110 error tolerance; WCAG 3.3.1 intent) call for identifying the error at the field and near the triggering action (clean variant: inline field errors + summary directly above the submit button).

defects.description: After a successful submission a toast with 60 characters (43 Hangul syllables) - containing the only notice that the booking is pending and will be confirmed via 카카오 알림톡 - is visible for 1.5 s (measured 1500 ms) and cannot be paused or reopened.
defects.human_factors_basis: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.2.1 Timing Adjustable (users must be able to extend/turn off time limits on content they need to read); Material 3 snackbar guidance (4-10 s, longer for longer text); reading-time estimate: even at a fast ~500 syllables/min, 43 syllables need ~5 s plus ~0.5-1 s to notice and shift gaze, i.e. >3x the display time.

defects.description: Primary '예약 신청하기' uses white 16 px bold text on #4a9af5 (2.90:1).
defects.human_factors_basis: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum): 16 px bold is not 'large text' (needs >=18.66 px bold), so 4.5:1 is required; it even fails the 3:1 large-text threshold. Low-contrast primary CTAs are also less salient and degrade further in bright ambient light.

decoys.description: Disabled '적용' button (no coupons available) with #aaaaaa text on #f1f3f5 (2.09:1). Acceptable: WCAG 1.4.3 exempts text in inactive (disabled) UI components.
Red low-stock badge ('⚠ 품절 임박 · 1개 남음', #c62828 on white 5.62:1). Looks like colour-coded status but the meaning is carried by an icon and text, so WCAG 1.4.1 is met and it is readable under CVD.

20x20 CSS px info icon next to '배송비 무료' with >=24 px edge-to-edge clearance from every other target (nearest: '적용' 24 px below). Acceptable under the WCAG 2.5.8 spacing exception; secondary, optional control.

'보내기' takes 1.2 s to complete, but a full-screen spinner with '보내는 중…' appears within ~50 ms of the tap (measured first DOM change 40-56 ms). Latency with immediate feedback is acceptable (Nielsen 1 s limit is about feedback, not duration).
Recent-transactions list colours outgoing amounts red and incoming green, but each amount also carries a '출금'/'입금' label and a −/+ sign; contrast 4.98:1 and 5.13:1. Not colour-only (WCAG 1.4.1 met).

44x44 '고객센터' help icon in the top-right corner, outside the one-handed natural zone. Acceptable: infrequent, secondary action not on the task path; placing rarely used controls at the top is the recommended pattern (Hoober 2013).
'개인정보 처리방침' link is only 17 px tall, but it is an inline link inside a sentence; WCAG 2.5.8 'Inline' exception applies, and the nearest other target is >70 px away.

'저장되었어요' toast (6 characters) is shown for 2.5 s just under the header, ~60 px (edge to edge) from the '저장' tap point, and the saved state also persists on the page ('변경사항 저장됨'). Short, redundant and near the focus point: not a timing or gaze problem.
Consent checkbox input is 20x20 CSS px, but it sits inside a full-width <label> (328x48) that toggles it, so the effective target is 48 px tall; nearest other target is >70 px away.
Late-arrival notice in grey (#6b6b6b on white) at 14 px looks faint but measures 5.33:1, passing WCAG 1.4.3 AA.

clean_controls.notes: checkout-clean.html: 44x44 close with 8 px gap; '전체 삭제' moved to the list header (far from pay) with a confirmation dialog; recently used payment method preselected with 2 alternatives and progressive disclosure for the other 9; helper text 14 px #4e5968 (7.1:1); pay button disables and shows a spinner + '결제 처리 중…' within ~50 ms. Decoys N-01..N-03 are present unchanged.

transfer-clean.html: '다음' is a full-width bottom button; quick-amount chips 59x48 with 8 px gaps; confirmation details 15 px #333d4b; limit error shown inside the still-open sheet directly above the buttons with icon and text (plus inline field errors). Decoys N-04, N-05 present unchanged.

settings-clean.html: '저장' is a full-width bottom button; switch off-state #6b7684 (4.6:1); logout and account deletion are separate 56 px rows in different groups (28 px apart) with confirmation dialogs; save toast shown just above the save button. Decoys N-06..N-08 present.

booking-clean.html: step-1 '다음' is a full-width bottom button; full slots show '마감' text, strike-through, dashed grey disabled style; inline field errors plus a summary directly above the submit button; submit #1b64da (5.41:1); short 4 s toast and the pending-confirmation notice persists on the completion screen. Decoys N-09, N-10 present.
